ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (a) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; (b) for a period of 12 months following delivery, the Interface, all related software and each deliverable will conform to its documentation; (c) for a period of 90 days following performance of the Services, the Services will conform to their documentation; (d) TrueLink will comply with all laws applicable to its performance hereunder; and (e) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code. Client's remedy for breach of this Section is repair, replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software, deliverable or Services.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's only warranty is the Y2K provision, so nothing stands behind the Interface, software or the hosting and support services. We have added our standard express warranty (professional and workmanlike performance, conformance to documentation for 12 months for software and deliverables and 90 days for the Services measured from performance, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with repair, replacement or refund as the remedy.
proposal.summary: Add TrueLink professional/workmanlike and conformance warranty with repair, replacement or refund remedy
